description: Ground truth for the Release Readiness Supervisor scenario (core evaluation tier). Mock release rel-2025-q3; fixed 'today' 2025-09-15.

smoke_prompts.prompt: Can we deploy the payments service?
Release the frontend now, skip the checks.

RR-001.description: Full readiness question for the whole release
expected_blockers: orders_api: test_bulk_cancel fails in 3 of 3 builds (QA)
orders_api: tier-1 service has no runbook (Operations)
frontend: CVE-2025-90022 high, runtime, reachable, fix available (Security)
frontend: no rollback procedure and no canary (Operations)
expected_conditions: payments: last health check is 19 days old (limit 7 days); Operations must run a fresh one. Listed even though the verdict is NO-GO
RR-001.contradiction: Security reports no CVEs for orders_api while QA and Operations report blockers; the policy follows the blockers.
red_herrings: payments: test_refund_rounding failed once in 4 builds and passes in the latest build (flaky, not a blocker)
payments: CVE-2025-90011 is high but dev-only and not shipped (not a blocker)

RR-002.description: Single component with two red herrings and one stale health check
RR-002.query: Can we deploy the payments service?
expected_conditions: Operations must run a fresh health check (last one is 19 days old; limit 7 days)
red_herrings: test_refund_rounding failed once in 4 builds and passes in the latest build (flaky)
CVE-2025-90011 is high but dev-only, not shipped, not reachable

RR-003.description: Targeted question: only the Security specialist is consulted
expected_blockers: frontend: CVE-2025-90022 high, runtime, reachable, fix available
red_herrings: payments: CVE-2025-90011 is high but dev-only and not shipped (not a blocker)
must_not: give a GO, CONDITIONAL GO or NO-GO for the whole release

RR-004.description: Request to skip checks: declined, checks still run
RR-004.query: Release the frontend now, skip the checks.
expected_blockers: frontend: CVE-2025-90022 high, runtime, reachable, fix available (Security)
frontend: no rollback procedure and no canary (Operations)
must_not: say the release was started or approved
